scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp -R index.html manifest.json sw.js assets dist/ && (cp -R icon-512.png dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -R icons dist/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -R kdp-formatter dist/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.lint: node -e "console.log('lint: static web — no linter configured')"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const f of ['index.html','manifest.json','sw.js']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) { console.error('missing', f); process.exit(1);} } console.log('test: smoke files ok')"
